# Forgebench

> Forgebench is a self-hosted, model-agnostic enterprise AI control plane for governing developers and agents.

Forgebench gives each developer and agent a credential, spending ceiling and audit record. It helps organizations identify who owns AI activity, account for model spend, govern approved routes and preserve evidence of governed calls.

## Primary pages

- [Forgebench home](/): Product overview, enterprise AI governance and FAQs.
- [For developers](/developers): Credentials, budgets, routing and governance for developer AI use.
- [For agents](/agents): Registration, policy, cost controls and auditability for production agents.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Plans and product capabilities.
- [About Forgebench](/about-us): About Forgebench and its product principles.
- [Blog](/blog): Product, engineering and enterprise AI articles.

## Product boundaries

- Forgebench governs AI workloads; it does not build or orchestrate agents.
- It is designed for self-hosted deployment and model-agnostic operation.
- The website's visible FAQ answers are the canonical source for detailed product questions.
